summary: LG Home key on webOS 3: Hearth learns which device takes it, and never retries.
Remote buttons stay after a restart; every remote screen shows what to do if the remote stops answering.
Quiet mode: a waking pointer clicks nothing.
Check for updates shows a progress bar and installs the version you chose.
Fix: the highlight no longer jumps to the first app by itself.
Fix: the LG Home button job works on more webOS 3 TVs (the right key device is chosen).
README: the SAM option is described and is now the first recommended setting.
New remote button job: LG Home (Map additional keys).
LG Home tile: a new way to open it on webOS 3 TVs.
Fix: Check for updates now also shows on TVs without root.
Check for updates: Hearth can install a newer version itself.
Reorder the home row right on the Home screen; new Glyph icon style.
New languages: Russian and Brazilian Portuguese.
Many fixes for webOS 3 TVs and the Home button.
New languages: Français and Polski.
Add Hearth as a TV input is back (one On/Off row).
New Uninstall apps button; wallpaper Fit or Fill; screen saver Dim 10 to 80 %.
Fix: a bundled photo you chose in 1.2.0 stays the same picture after updating.
New Settings layout, many more looks and themes, a screen saver.
A Home button that needs no other app, languages, a full app list without root.
